exposure: number of embryos transferred (single vs. double)
day of embryo transfer (day 4 vs. day 5)
cohort: 1963 women who underwent fresh transfer cycles using the early follicular phase extra-long protocol for assisted conception between September 2017 and September 2020
finding: Day 4 morula transfer may be a good alternative to day 5 blastocyst transfer, but the choice between single and double embryo transfer needs to be adapted for day 4 transfers.
mod_finding: In double embryo transfer, the D4 group had a lower newborn birthweight and a larger proportion of low birthweight infants compared to the D5 group.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome, but not specified
